rationale: Price is at 96.7% of today's range after a massive intraday surge (from ~$12.50 low to $15.24 high), sitting just below the session high with no news catalyst identified. The stock is extended well above VWAP ($14.40) and the 9-EMA ($14.89), making a long entry at current levels high-risk for a reversal, while shorting near-highs on a stock with 3.84x relative volume and strong momentum carries equal risk of continuation. With no clear edge in either direction and the position already near exhaustion of the day's range, skipping preserves capital.
